name: Marin Humane - Pet Safety Net
description: Help with vet care, spay/neuter, vaccines, food, rental deposits, and more for very low income Marin residents
fullDescription: Marin Humane's Pet Safety Net helps low-income Marin County residents pay for veterinary care, vaccinations, food, and other services so they can keep their pets.
whatTheyOffer:
- Veterinary treatment with good prognosis (through pre-approved local vets)
- Spay/neuter assistance, vaccinations, and microchips
- Free community clinics
- Pet food and supplies
- Pet rental deposits and dog license fees
- Behavior and training help, medical grooming, and humane euthanasia
howToGetIt:
1. Must be 18+, live in Marin County with your pet, and be the pet's regular caretaker
2. Household income must be at or below HUD very low income limits
3. Submit an application with proof of income for all household members, proof of residency, and proof you are the pet's guardian
4. For vet care, call the Pet Safety Net office at 415-506-6255 for pre-authorization before making an appointment (past expenses can't be reimbursed)
5. Pets must be spayed/neutered (or have a plan to be) and dogs licensed; help is available once every two calendar years, as funds allow
address: 171 Bel Marin Keys Blvd, Novato, CA 94949
keywords: Marin Humane, Pet Safety Net, vet assistance, pet food, spay neuter assistance, pet rental deposit, free community clinics, low income, Novato, pet care
